title: Draw ray diagrams for concave mirrors (virtual image)

hook.scenario: Shaving mirror ya makeup mirror ke bahut paas jao, toh aapka chehra ekdum seedha aur bada dikhta hai. Par thoda door hatein toh image ulti (inverted) ho jati hai.
hook.question: Ek hi mirror aapko seedha aur ulta dono kaise dikha sakta hai?

mental_model.intuition: Limit cross karne par magic! (P aur F ke beech)
mental_model.description: Jab object concave mirror ke itna paas chala jata hai ki woh Focus (F) ko cross karke Pole (P) aur F ke beech aa jaye, toh rules palat jate hain. Image real nahi banti, balki mirror ke andar (behind) banti hai. Yeh image virtual, erect (seedhi) aur enlarged hoti hai.

explanation:
Concave mirrors normally real aur inverted images banate hain. Par unke paas ek special power hoti hai jab object unke bahut nazdeek (F aur P ke beech) rakha jaye. Is case mein reflected rays mirror ke front mein kabhi nahi milti kyunki woh diverge (fail) hone lagti hain.

Jab aap in diverging rays ko backward trace (peeche ki taraf draw) karte ho dotted lines se, toh aisa lagta hai jaise yeh rays mirror ke peeche kisi point se aa rahi hain. Kyunki light rays actually wahan nahi mil rahi hain, isliye image 'Virtual' hoti hai. Aisi image ko screen par capture nahi kiya ja sakta, aapko usay mirror ke andar hi dekhna padta hai.

Virtual images hamesha 'Erect' (seedhi) hoti hain. Concave mirror ki virtual image ki sabse khaas baat yeh hai ki yeh humesha object se badi (enlarged) hoti hai. Yahi wajah hai ki dentists isko teeth ko zoom in karke dekhne ke liye use karte hain, aur hum isay shaving ya makeup ke liye use karte hain.

worked_example.problem: A dentist holds a small concave mirror near a tooth. The tooth is between the pole and focus. What kind of image does the dentist see?

steps.narration: Concave mirror mein object P aur F ke beech rakha hai.
Rays reflection ke baad diverge hongi aur mirror ke peeche milti hui dikhengi.

worked_example.problem: Can you project the image formed by a concave mirror when the object is between P and F on a screen?

steps.narration: Virtual images rays ke apparent intersection se banti hain, actual mein nahi.

worked_example.answer: No, because the image is virtual.

common_mistakes.title: Drawing solid lines behind the mirror
common_mistakes.explanation: Light mirror ke paar nahi ja sakti! Mirror ke peeche wali lines ko hamesha dotted (---) banayein to show ki woh virtual hain.

recall_questions.q: What is the nature of the image when an object is placed between the pole and focus of a concave mirror?
Can a virtual image be obtained on a screen?
Where must the object be placed to form a virtual image with a concave mirror?
recall_questions.answer: Between the pole (P) and the principal focus (F).

oa_questions.question: A student places an object 10 cm from a concave mirror of focal length 15 cm. State the nature and magnification (in terms of >1 or <1) of the image formed.
oa_questions.approach: Since u (10 cm) is less than f (15 cm), object is between P and F.

oa_questions.question: Why do dentists use concave mirrors?
oa_questions.answer: To see a magnified, virtual, and erect image of the teeth when placed very close.
oa_questions.approach: Connect the virtual image case (object between P and F) to the real-world application.
